posts.text:
Six Grok Bot recipes, each run against production and written down as it happened.

A recipe is the exact sentence to hand Grok Bot, the tools it calls in order, and the real output: a daily 3D brief, a game jam asset pack, an avatar from a photo, an X post's image as a 3D model, a weekly agent report, and a $THREE market brief. Recipes 1 to 4 use the free connector with no account.

The asset pack run searched the ready-made catalog for trees, kept only models under 10 MB, and listed four CC0 picks with license, size and viewer link, with every tool call timed. Nothing on the page is invented, and the script that captured each output reruns any recipe.
The sentences, the runs and the rerun script: three.ws/tutorials/grok-bot-recipes
